First public release of **Cadre**, a video editor with an AI assistant built in.

## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 and later) | `Cadre-mac-apple-silicon.dmg` |
| Mac with Intel processor | `Cadre-mac-intel.dmg` |
| Windows 10/11 (64-bit) | `Cadre-Setup-x64.exe` |

These builds are not code-signed yet. On macOS, open System Settings › Privacy & Security › **Open Anyway** after the
first launch attempt. On Windows, click **More info** › **Run anyway** in SmartScreen.

On first launch Cadre sets up its engine (a few minutes, once). The assistant needs either a
[Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) sign-in or an Anthropic API key; manual editing works without it.

## Highlights

- Describe the video you want when creating a project: the assistant imports and transcribes your media, shows its
  plan as a checklist and builds the edit step by step on a real multitrack timeline.
- Everything stays editable: free placement and gaps on the main track, stacked video tracks, linked / unlinked audio
  (J- and L-cuts), title cards with your logo, effects with presets, color page with scopes, mixer.
- Reference videos: give a link and the assistant analyzes its frames, speech, sounds and music to match the style.
- Built-in styles including Gaming and Vertical gaming clip, plus your own styles written from a description.
- Local transcription (Whisper); export to H.264, HEVC, ProRes, 4K, WAV, SRT captions and XML for Premiere Pro /
  DaVinci Resolve.
- Interface in English, French, Spanish, German, Italian, Portuguese and Japanese.

See the [README](https://github.com/kiy0ni/cadre#readme) for details.
